result_json.message: docs: add plan review for implementation-review governance plan 210

items.title: Define when a separate execution run must bind to an approved plan
items.reason: Mode is pinned only at baseline capture; a fresh execution run has no baseline, and the plan never defines what makes an unbound execution context enforced, so IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED has no trigger.
items.failure: Operator starts a new execution run without review implementation bind; it silently takes the off/v1 path and bypasses all Phase 9 completion, reconciliation and gate guards.
items.lowestCostCorrection: At the first implementation author admission, require a binding when the plan has a Delivery Budget and resolved mode is not off; auto-resolve a unique approved source run for the canonical plan via RecordStore, else return IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; add a bypass test.

items.title: Capture pre-author HEAD as the initial phase diff base
items.reason: Author results record one commit, but authors can make several git:commit steps per session; the parent of the first recorded author-result commit excludes that session's earlier commits.
items.failure: Reviewed range omits part of the phase's code, so diff-causal validation rejects legitimate blockers in unreviewed commits and review misses defects.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Record the pre-delegation HEAD at the first same-phase author admission (template render/invoke) and use it as the base, verifying ancestry; for legacy history fall back to the parent of the earliest same-phase git:commit record, else the explicit context error.

items.title: Reconcile approval-drift detection with guarded text-only amendments
items.reason: Phase 1 treats any change other than checkbox state as drift needing amendment, and Phase 9 requires the plan's current committed scope, but Phase 5 authorizes guard-verified wording edits without a plan decision.
items.failure: After one legitimate text_only amendment, the plan hash no longer matches approval and the boundary denies phase completion or forces an unnecessary amendment workflow.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Measure drift against approved bytes plus the chain of guard-verified amendment commits (and checkbox-only changes); add a text-only-to-phase:complete lifecycle test.

items.title: Specify claim-assessment carry-forward across the final-correction shortcut
items.reason: Phase 7 invalidates claim assessments on any later target-phase code change, while the Phase 6 shortcut, by definition, lands a code commit after assessment and completes without re-review.
items.failure: In phases with due claims the shortcut either can never complete or bypasses reconciliation, depending on implementation order.
items.lowestCostCorrection: State that the originating observation's assessments carry forward only through a CLI-recorded passing eligible correction attempt with zero architecture delta, empty boundary changes and a clean changed-path inventory; any other code change invalidates. Add a Phase 11 lifecycle case.

items.title: Define the planImpact schema including text-only locations
items.reason: Phase 2 adds planImpact but never gives its shape, while Phase 5's guard needs machine-checkable allowed text locations and Phase 10 examples must match concrete fields.
items.failure: The guard cannot determine which wording edits are authorized, so implementations either allow arbitrary non-table edits or reject all text-only passes.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Define planImpact as {kind: text_only|design|budget, locations:[{heading, staleText}]}; locations must be non-empty for text_only and each staleText must be unique under its heading at the approved commit; the guard allows byte changes only in those spans plus checkboxes; if missing or ambiguous, route to a human.

items.title: Renumber the planned migration from v10 to v11
items.reason: The dependency already ships schema version 10 (plan-review closure context) at src/db/schema.ts:589, yet the Architecture, Phase 8 and Files Touched name v10 and schema-v10.test.ts.
items.failure: The implementer could try to reuse or renumber the shipped v10 migration, breaking upgrades of existing databases.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Replace the v10 references with v11 / schema-v11.test.ts and list v10 among the verified dependency seams in Phase 0 and the Overview.

result_json.summary: The plan is grounded in verified plan-209 seams and reuses the shipped record/CAS authority. Five mechanical P1 gaps (execution-run binding trigger, initial diff base, drift vs text-only amendments, shortcut vs claim invalidation, planImpact schema) and one migration-number correction are needed before implementation.

baselineAssessment.reason: Eleven work items reuse shipped 209 seams; W1 cross-run binding/rebuild, W3 git range edge cases and W8 domain-generalized CAS/acceptance plus migration each look about one point light versus the 47-point ledger.
